posts.title: Now we’re going to get a Bruxelles and Amsterdam to Milano night train. Or are we?
posts.description: After yesterday’s news that Basel-Malmö will not happen, today there’s news that a new night train route will open up – European Sleeper is proposing to run from Bruxelles and Amsterdam to Switzerland and Milano from June 2026. Their press release about it is here (PDF). A few of relevant […]

posts.title: A little short term subsidy for this or that route is no way to support night trains – lessons from the end of Basel-Malmö before it even started
posts.description: So there will not be a Basel – Malmö night train from the spring of 2026. Switzerland’s parliament did not approve the subsidy to allow it to run. Without the 10 million CHF the parliament refused to grant to get this going (from a wider fund of 47 million CHF […]

posts.title: SNCF’s half hearted effort to support international night trains in danger of hitting the buffers
posts.description: In December 2023 the Paris-Berlin night train re-started after a 9 year hiatus. Operated as a Nighjet service by ÖBB, SNCF provided motive power for the train from Mannheim to Paris.
